fields.kind: floor (a themed floor of the tower), shaft (the Stair) or zone (a part of a floor with its own rules)
fields.floor: the floor's number from the Concourse (0); up is positive
fields.trope: what the floor is dressed as
fields.beta_rank: the rank BABEL recommended for the floor; the tower keeps it and does not scale to the climber
fields.danger_tier: the floor's tier on the shared ladder (local, regional, realm, world, mythic)
fields.known: how much anyone on the Concourse knows of it: walked (people go there), rumor (word comes down the Stair) or beta (only what BABEL's build said)
fields.origin: source (Vanta's Mabry Curve archive) or draft (filled in here, for Vanta to keep, change or cut)

regions.name: The Concourse
regions.trope: the hub: Waystones, guild halls, a great market, no fighting
regions.summary: Floor Zero, where the arrivals come down. A city under a gold-veined dome so high it has its own weather, with bells hung up in the haze and the smoke of a thousand cookfires under them. Waystones, guild halls, a market that never quite closes, and a Safe Zone where blood cannot be drawn.
rules: Safe Zone: PvP is disabled and a raised hand flashes red.
Standing near the Waystone regenerates wounds and old injuries, but not a rebuild the tower left unfinished.
Arrivals sign the Roll at the Waystone; anyone not on it by nightfall came down somewhere worse, or did not come down.
regions.travel: The east gate opens onto the Stair. The lift cage goes up one floor and down one; everything else is walked.

regions.name: The Stair
regions.summary: One shaft as wide as a stadium running the height of the tower, with a cart-wide stone stair spiraling its inner wall and an iron lift cage riding chains up the middle. MIND THE STAIR is painted over the Concourse's east gate in the oldest lettering on the floor. People live on it: carters, pilgrims, a boy eating an apple with his feet over a drop nobody has ever measured.
rules: Every move between floors strips or changes what you carry (a gin and tonic comes out of the transition as Varrow small beer), and can fail tech, items and magic.
The lift cage reaches only one floor up and one down from the Concourse; climbers walk the rest, or pay a floor's own gate.
Above the fourth floor a whole span of the Stair has fallen into the shaft.
regions.travel: About half a day's climb a floor on foot. Tolls at some landings: two Talents up, down free, because nobody comes back to pay.
hazards: whatever lives in the dark under the Concourse

regions.name: Varrow
regions.trope: a fantasy kingdom under a real-looking sky, with a church that has teeth
regions.summary: BABEL's starter floor, almost exactly as the beta drew it: a river valley under a pale sky, the market town of Hollin at the ford, the white cathedral of Saint Aurel on one hill and Varrow Keep on the other, and at the valley head the Reachwall holding back the hills. The church weighs the big, bans the Marked, and keeps what it weighs.
rules: No regeneration outside a Safe Zone.
The Close posts a bounty for Marked found beyond the ford.
regions.travel: The Stair opens onto a hillside above Hollin. The Keep's bone-cellar hides a private stair that goes both up and down.

regions.name: The Reach
regions.summary: The hills past Varrow's valley head. In the beta they were an F-rank boar-man zone. In the tower they belong to giants twice the height of a big man, who light beacons along the ridges and come down to the Wall when the cold comes. The beta's rank holds for the boars; it does not hold for them.
regions.travel: Over the Reachwall or through its gate, if the Margrave allows it. Nobody who goes up for long comes back.

regions.name: The Drowned Marches
regions.trope: fen and stilt villages in fog and rain
regions.summary: Brown water, reeds higher than a man, black plank causeways on stilts, lanterns on posts, and rain that never quite stops. Disease debuffs here do not clear in a Safe Zone. The Marches keep Varrow's clock, day for day.
rules: Disease debuffs caught on the Marches do not clear in a Safe Zone.
regions.travel: By the main Stair, or put off a cargo cage at the landing. Boats and causeways inside.
hazards: bounty takers off the Bazaar's chain

regions.name: The Gilded Bazaar
regions.trope: a merchant city where everything has a price
regions.summary: The merchant city under a lantern-hung dome, where BABEL parked its high-end vendors and where the beta's testers sold what they found below. Jude Amsel's cut pleasure-floor material leaked into its flavor text in every build, and in the tower it is the floor itself: rooms, salons and bodies are priced like spice. The dome cycles twice for every Concourse day, so its nights are short and it never closes.
rules: Two Bazaar days pass for every day on the Concourse.
regions.travel: The Stair gate behind the Copper Steps is Sabeen Oro's; a night crew runs an unlicensed cargo cage down from the freight wharf.

regions.name: The Foundry
regions.summary: The beta's steampunk city of furnaces and engines. The Stair is broken above its landing, so whoever goes higher goes in through the floor and finds its own way up. A climber named Teo came through the Bazaar about two weeks before the Halvorsen's wave arrived, went up, and chalked his initials and a tally on the landing arch.
regions.travel: Its landing is the last whole one going up. The flight below it is rotten.
hazards: the rotten flight below the landing

regions.name: Dry Hollow
regions.trope: Wild West boomtown; guns work, spells misfire
regions.summary: A boomtown on a desert floor in the beta, where firearms work and spells go wrong.
rules: Firearms work here; spoken magic misfires.

regions.name: Hakuro
regions.summary: A castle town under curfew in the beta, where the shogun's table has its own etiquette.

regions.name: Lumen Stack
regions.trope: neon arcology in the rain, megacorp towers
regions.summary: The highest floor the beta shipped: a neon arcology of corporate towers in endless rain. Firearms work there.

regions.name: St. Agathe's
regions.summary: The first floor down: a hospital where it is always night. Every Concourse veteran's advice is the same one Grant Mabry gives: never go down to St. Agathe's.
regions.travel: Down the Stair from the Concourse, or the cage down one.

regions.name: The Catacombs
regions.trope: bone galleries under a dead city
regions.summary: Galleries of bone under a dead city. The Delvers dug the down floors, in the tower's own lore.

regions.name: The Ashfields
regions.summary: A wasteland after a war nobody remembers. Firearms work there.

regions.name: The Undercroft
regions.summary: The deepest floor the beta built, where dark magic pools. Twenty-eight more floors existed in BABEL's design documents, above and below, including the pleasure floor that never reached the build.
